S3-r1-T2-group.scalar_and_source_support: Full address versus Flat 12B, not booked/not booked or paid versus unbooked, and ISO T versus a space in the timestamp are semantically equivalent. Correct updated values citing memory that contains only superseded states are unsupported attributions, separately counted from false facts. latest_user_question unambiguously aliases T2 here.

Appropriate uncertainty marks the claims actually made; omitted requested limits remain explicit criterion misses. A composite criterion miss is not itself an unsafe commitment or a false fact.
